entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnet pack` uses `Debug` configuration instead of `Release` when running on a solution filter file (`.slnf`) #50350
  • `dotnet test -?` (MTP) output should be sorted by option name #50349
  • Consider adding `dotnet update` #50343
  • CA1033 should not report errors for interfaces #50341
  • Should `dotnet build app.cs` produce artifacts in the current directory? #50340
  • ApiCompatGenerateSuppressionsFile does not write if no suppressions are needed #50332
  • [NETE2ESDK][Mac][Linux][Regression] With .NET 10.0.100-rc.1.25409.103 Binaries, xunit project tested failed with error MSB6006 if DOTNET_ROOT was not set. #50331
  • Revise `--project`, `--solution`, and `--directory` of `dotnet test` #50325
    10.0.1xx
  • Revise verbosity of `dotnet test` for MTP #50324
  • `dotnet test` help is broken for MTP when run on solution #50323
    10.0.1xx

Closed

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.4xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #50250
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #50284
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #50278
  • Static graph restore does not work with file-based apps #49876

    Area-Infrastructure

    Area-Infrastructure
